item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"item_id":"feed:https://www.engineering.com/?p=151563","version_id":"90e3adc0a87a45dc20689ae62db7125fe378f8191522f5954fae4ace5e96c803","decision":"accept","reason":"Relevant, fresh independent trade reporting (published 2026-09-30) tests Backflip’s drawing-, photo-, and video-to-CAD capabilities rather than merely repeating its announcement. The author imported two generated STEP files into Fusion, assigned the specified material, and reports exact agreement with the TooTallToby target masses; that check supports geometry and volume/mass correctness for those two constrained drawings, not manufacturability or general CAD reliability. The same test records a seven-body drawing failure and incomplete feature-tree reconstruction in Fusion, while photo-derived geometry was dimensionally inaccurate, creating useful evidence tension. Backflip’s CEO claim that the model infers familiar-object dimensions remains an attributed commercial claim; reproducible task sets, disclosed settings and attempt counts, and independent tests would be needed to establish broader performance.","piece_ids":["01","02","03"]}
